Tab indented package.json keeps its tabs.
-- changes --
[{"name":"semver","ecosystem":"npm","to":"7.7.2","method":"override","file":"package.json"}]
-- in:package.json --
{
	"name": "app",
	"dependencies": {
		"express": "^4.18.0"
	}
}
-- out:package.json --
{
	"name": "app",
	"dependencies": {
		"express": "^4.18.0"
	},
	"overrides": {
		"semver": "7.7.2"
	}
}
